courses.subject: YOR
courses.title: Beginning Yoruba
courses.description: An intensive beginning course with an emphasis on basic skills: listening, speaking, reading, and writing. Six lecture hours a week for one semester. Yoruba 601C and 506 may not both be counted. Yoruba 601C and 507 may not both be counted.

courses.subject: YOR
courses.title: First-Year Yoruba I
courses.description: Restricted to non-native speakers of Yoruba. Standard Yoruba of southwest Nigeria. Five lecture hours a week for one semester. Yoruba 601C and 506 may not both be counted.
courses.restricted: Restricted to non-native speakers of Yoruba.

courses.subject: YOR
courses.title: First-Year Yoruba II

courses.prereqText: Yoruba 506 with a grade of at least C.
courses.restricted: Restricted to non-native speakers of Yoruba.
